integrity_notes: Proof self-contained; scientific source attributions and verification limitations given; external independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite-permutation Zhang twists of free commutative monoids, not arbitrary twisting systems or Yang--Baxter solutions.
The rank of the structure-group abelianization and two small permutation examples are previously established; only the all-cycle torsion and center laws are evaluated as new.
Possible implicit equivalence in historical I-type structure group literature cannot be eliminated by finite search.
Bounded Smith normal form computations are consistency checks, not an infinite proof.
title: Orbit-gcd torsion and degree-congruence centers of permutation Zhang twists
